subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster pair.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) FH-HJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16e0b93bf6330778b5838f74e7a0efbd83277feb93bd1a8c4c378e9c9d70bc6b.png] 

Option 2) IK-KM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c3925965cad7d477f41d4673053942f1fb4d22f7f23a117f0c8cc39f15c4a7b.png] 

Option 3) MO-OQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9997e1b5286d4fe8041695a42e6fe33abdf9aa064cd0902b45742197a17c7f8a.png] 

**Option 4) RT-TB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d0ab59ffd93653db52aca219913df747c748d5479a5919dce6b81fe63360bfa.png] 

Here, 'RT-TB' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
